optimizedContext.value:
# SDK Composition

## Rules

- packages/sdk runtime deps only @specd/core and @specd/code-graph; never CLI/MCP/plugins. Composition host/lifecycle, orchestration, pure presentation, private shared, explicit index barrel.
- No domain entities/ports/adapters; shared never exported. Exports . index, ./ports core ports, ./extensions core extensions.
- Public barrel explicitly exports openSpecdHost/createSdkContext/withOpenGraphProvider, project/index/review orchestration plus I/O, presentation, curated Core/Graph host APIs/types, SDK_VERSION, codeGraphVersion/getCodeGraphVersion.
- Core set tracks kernel.specs metadata materialize/read/regenerate/init, persisted schema/dependency/implementation/optimization use cases + factories. Never wildcard Core, infrastructure/internal symbols, SaveSpecMetadata/UpdateSpecMetadata/InvalidateSpecMetadata or factories, PersistSpecMetadata.
- Re-export graph locks/health/index-hotspot-impact types, GraphSpecNotFoundError, symbol/search/risk options and selector/config/fingerprint helpers.
- Delivery hosts using Core+Graph import/depend SDK only. Core-only plugins/skills may direct Core. SDK_VERSION matches package version.

## Constraints

- Thin composition/orchestration; no duplicate host bootstrap/infrastructure.
- Presentation no I/O; src/shared private.
